question:
The percentage distribution of employees in different categories in a company is shown by the following pie chart.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45ed1e3f94939782aec2eb16ea81c824668d8a06eb747382f6d10c962f0438fd.png] 

What is the central angle corresponding to the employees of Group-B?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Percent distribution of employees for Group B = 35%

Central angle = 35/100 × 360

⇒ 126° 

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
